active_family: state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law with one stochastic source and one shared generative core; first backend remains AR flow matching unless diagnostics justify a switch
single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Allowed differences are input/output dimensionality, support transforms, input heads, decoder heads, generic support-aware mixed discrete-continuous heads selected by one data-derived rule, and deterministic channel/group balancing. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, factor-name-specific sparse heads, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.
current_framework_status: 734a evaluated a real-VIX frozen continuous normalized-innovation AR-flow recipe across iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. The framework gate passed: one generated coordinate, one AR flow backend, one stochastic source, one shared encoder/transition core, and one loss recipe, with only support/head/dimensionality differences. Model gates did not pass: IV-only was 6/11, joint IV-slice was 6/11, and anchor/joint panel gates failed factor-delta KS on AAA/BBB OAS and US2Y.
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, output_law, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: The continuous normalized-innovation law is coherent but not yet deployable as a general tri-scope model. IV realism remains broadly good but calibration/regime coverage still fail; the joint checkpoint preserves IV-factor co-movement but slightly interferes with IV kurtosis/mean-reversion. Anchor and joint panels pass finite paths, tail scale, factor correlations, IV-factor correlation, and conditional panel response, but fail factor-delta KS because low-activity OAS/rate channels have support/frequency mismatch and some generated levels leave plausible support.
last_result_summary: 734a real-VIX framework-lock baseline: IV-only full suite 6/11 with failures coverage, conditionality, cointegration, regime_coverage, distributional_fidelity, but risk-state allocation passed. Joint checkpoint IV slice also 6/11 with failures coverage, conditionality, time_series, regime_coverage, mean_reversion; cointegration, median bias, correlation, and pathwise jumps passed. Anchor panel: finite_rate 1.0, factor_delta_ks_mean 0.1069, 12/14 factors pass KS<0.20, tail q99 14/14 pass, factor_corr upper_corr 0.902, conditional width rho 0.924. Joint panel: finite_rate 1.0, factor_delta_ks_mean 0.0969, 12/14 pass, tail q99 14/14 pass, factor_corr upper_corr 0.861, IV-factor corr 0.943, conditional width rho 0.945. Sticky audit says history-RMS scaling does not fully stationarize OAS tails: AAA normalized q99 11.60 train vs 4.30 validation and BBB 6.26 vs 3.66.
next_step_recommendation: Choose post_experiment_analysis or a decisive experiment targeting one generic support/frequency-aware output law. Do not switch backend or add factor-name-specific rules. The most principled next experiment is a data-derived low-activity/mixed-support head or coordinate selected by no-change/near-no-change and support statistics, applied uniformly across iv_only, anchor_only, and joint while preserving the same AR flow core and scalar loss recipe. Before implementing, audit generated move-event rates and nonzero-jump tails for AAA/BBB/US2Y/VIX to decide whether the repair should be a mixed discrete-continuous output law, support-bounded inverse transform, or objective reweighting.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain historical IV-only controls. 719a remains the pre-real-VIX unified methodology baseline: IV 7/11 with broad temporal/spatial realism, anchor/joint factor tails and conditional response passing, IV-factor co-movement passing, and residual failures concentrated in IV calibration plus BBB/AAA OAS sticky-spread marginals. Because observed VIX changed the factor panel, do not claim a current real-VIX tri-scope champion until rerun.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
